sections.title: Introduction
sections.extract: 1 GAUSSIAN FLUCTUATIONS OF CHARACTERS OF SYMMETRIC GROUPS AND OF YOUNG DIAGRAMS ABSTRACT. We study asymptotics of reducible representations of the symmetric groups Sq for large q. We decompose such a representation as a sum of irreducible components (or, alternatively, Young diagrams) and we ask what is the character of a randomly chosen component (or, what is the shape of a randomly chosen Young diagram).
